data_availability_text: Data availabilityThe full network is available and explorable at https://fraenkel-lab.github.io/neurodegeneration-network/. The RNA-seq data from the laser-capture microdissection temporal cortex pyramidal neurons has been deposited at the Gene Expression Omnibus at the accession number GSE261775. The RNA-seq data from NGN2-expressing neural progenitor cells is deposited at the Gene Expression Omnibus at the accession number GSE261878. Source data are provided with this paper.
sections_present: a genome-scale, forward genetic screen for neurodegeneration in drosophila
gene expression of the human orthologs of the neurodegeneration screen hits declines with age and alzheimer’s disease in the human brain
human genetic risk factors enriched in disease-associated neurons complement results from the neurodegeneration screen
proteomics, phosphoproteomics and metabolomics from drosophila models of tauopathy or amyloid β neurotoxicity show significant changes in neurodegeneration screen hits in disease contexts
network integration of alzheimer’s disease omics and novel genetic screening data identifies subnetworks representing biological processes underlying neurodegeneration in alzheimer’s disease
network integration of alzheimer’s disease omics and genetic hits reveals hnrnpa2b1 and mepce as targets that regulate tau-mediated neurotoxicity
network analysis implicates csnk2a1 and notch1 as regulators of the alzheimer’s disease-associated biological process of dna damage repair in neurons
transcriptomic analysis suggests how csnk2a1 and notch1 knockdown could lead to age-associated neurodegeneration through distinct dna-damaging pathways
declaration of consent for human subjects
quantitative mass spectrometry sample preparation for proteomics
identifying age-associated genes in rna-seq data from the genotype-tissue expression (gtex) project
data sets used for expression quantitative trait locus (eqtl) analysis
genotype data processing for eqtl analyses
imputation of genotypes for eqtl analyses
identifying egene-associated variants that associate with transcription factor binding
implementation of robust to compare to the result of omicsintegrator
comparison of omicsintegrator to a graph neural network and gnnexplainer
semiquantitative scale for assaying the drosophila rough eye phenotype
betweenness analysis of neurodegeneration screen hits with regulators of dna damage
comet assay for dna damage in human neural progenitor cells
ngn2 neuronal differentiation and rna extraction
bulk rna-seq analysis of crispri knockdowns in neural progenitor cells
ethical acquisition of human patient data
